Camp Fire Bacon & Eggs
By: Anonymous
Published: Sunday, December 27, 2009 - 11:32pm

Ingredients




1 stick or roasting fork
1 paper sack
1 strip of bacon
1 egg

Preparation

1 Place piece of bacon in bottom of small paper lunch sack. Extend over coals of camp fire or charcoal fire using stick or roasting fork. Be careful not to let bottom of sack touch the coals. As bacon cooks the bottom of the sack will be coated with bacon grease. When bacon is almost cooked, break egg into sack. Continue holding sack over coals. When egg is cooked, peel back top of sack and eat out of the bag.
